NSU
Novosibirsk State University (NSU) is a prominent higher education institution dedicated to providing comprehensive academic programs and infrastructure for its student body. As a center for learning and research, the university serves as the primary environment for the employment of diverse teaching staff and the facilitation of scholarly development.

The university is organized into several specialized academic divisions, including the Faculty of Information Technology (FIT), which focuses on computing and digital sciences. Additionally, Novosibirsk State University hosts the Faculty of Economics and the Faculty of Natural Sciences, reflecting its broad commitment to both social and empirical disciplines. Through these various faculties, the institution maintains a robust academic framework designed to support students across a wide range of fields.<SEP>Novosibirsk State University is an educational institution that hosts the Institute of Intelligent Robotics.<SEP>NSU is the Novosibirsk State University, an educational institution that hosts the Institute of Medicine and Medical Technology.

Novosibirsk State University
Novosibirsk State University (NSU) is a prominent higher education institution that integrates a diverse range of academic disciplines, including natural sciences, engineering, and the humanities. The university is structured around several specialized faculties and departments, which facilitate its comprehensive educational mission.

The academic infrastructure of Novosibirsk State University includes the Faculty of Natural Sciences, the Faculty of Physics, and the Faculty of Geology and Geophysics. Furthermore, the institution supports advanced technical and analytical studies through its Mechanics and Mathematics Department, as well as the Faculty of Information Technologies. In addition to these scientific and technical fields, the university maintains a Faculty of Economics, reflecting its commitment to a broad spectrum of scholarly competencies.

Novosibirsk State University offers a variety of bachelor's degree programs designed to prepare students for professional and academic careers. Beyond its core academic offerings, the institution provides a range of student services to support the educational experience of its diverse student body.<SEP>Novosibirsk State University is an educational institution that hosts the Institute of Intelligent Robotics.
